sources.use_review_basis: Current first-party October 2026 wines/spirits PDF is linked from owner La Drogheria site. Exact published static/OSM n4413587403 at Piazza Vittorio Veneto 18d in Torino. On spirit pages, the PDF explicitly marks the second amount with *Versione miscelata; mixer composition and serving volume are unstated. Paired wines with no glass/bottle legend, ambiguous beer layout, and one unstarred mixed-price interpretation are held. 2025 cocktail PDF exceeds current source-size guard and is not included.
